subjects.name: General Hindi
subjects.scope_note: This covers Hindi grammar, vocabulary, official terminology, and letter writing. Focus on linguistic skills in Hindi.

subjects.name: General English
subjects.scope_note: This covers English grammar, sentence structure, vocabulary, and translation. Focus on linguistic skills in English.

subjects.name: Geography of Rajasthan
subjects.scope_note: Covers the physical features, climate, resources, population, and environmental aspects specific to Rajasthan.

subjects.name: History, Art and Culture of Rajasthan
subjects.name_hindi: राजस्थान का इतिहास, कला एवं संस्कृति
subjects.scope_note: Focuses on historical events, freedom movement, art forms, culture, traditions, and personalities of Rajasthan.

subjects.name: Indian Constitution and Political & Administrative System of Rajasthan
subjects.name_hindi: भारतीय संविधान एवं राजस्थान राज्य में राजनीतिक एवं प्रशासनिक व्यवस्था
subjects.scope_note: Covers the basics of the Indian Constitution and the political and administrative structure and governance of Rajasthan.

subjects.name: General Science
subjects.scope_note: Includes topics from Physics, Chemistry, and Biology, focusing on fundamental concepts and their applications.

subjects.name: Major Current Events
subjects.scope_note: Covers recent events and developments in sports, politics, economy, social, geographical, cultural, ecological, and technical fields, with a focus on both national and Rajasthan-specific issues and personalities.

subjects.name: Basic Computer
subjects.scope_note: Covers fundamental computer concepts, hardware, software, operating systems, and common office applications like MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Internet, and Email.

subjects.name: Mathematics
subjects.scope_note: Covers arithmetic topics such as HCF, LCM, average, profit-loss, percentage, interest, ratio-proportion, partnership, time and work, time, speed and distance, and data representation.
